title: T-70 (bundle 20261114-110317, mod 0.3.3: 'if you rent scooter your friend can't use it'). REPRODUCE + MEASURE, no fix: the host rents an e-scooter the game's way, the merged friend gets on it, throttles 5 s, and vehmove records kinematic/frozen counts and the distance moved on both machines (suspect A: the copy's rigidbodies are frozen kinematic). The owner then clicks his scooter while the friend rides (suspect B: board request on a 0-seat scooter) and the toast he is shown is logged. Reverse: the owner rides, the friend's click meets the designed 'owner-using' refusal. Ends dissolved; NO save.
preconditions: Fixture save1 (host melaus, Client1), the host outdoors near a loaded scooter rental point with money for the fee. Dev build with the T-70 levers (DevT70.cs): rentscooter, vehmove <vid> [seconds], throttle <0..1> [seconds], ghostclick <vid>, and the DEV toast log line '[TestDrive] toast: '...''; plus drive/board/ride/exitride (H-OWNERRIDE).
oracles_report: \[TestDrive\] toast: 'Someone is using this right now\.'

steps.note: ghosts respawn drivable on both machines after the membership edge
PREMISE: the host rents an e-scooter through the rental point's own Interact + confirm (fee, CreateVehicle); the game mounts the renter one frame later
REPORT (baseline): the owner's own scooter while the owner rides it - kinematic/frozen/NWH counts
PREMISE: the rent mounted the host; the host parks and stands beside it
the fleet broadcast carries the rented scooter; the client's drivable copy spawns
PREMISE: the client holds a copy of the host's scooter. REPORT: its kinematic/frozen/NWH counts while parked
the friend gets on the host's scooter (explicit vid: the passenger-seat filter is skipped)
walk to the scooter + native EnterVehicle; the drive stream starts
PREMISE: the client IS driving the host's scooter
REPORT (suspect A): kinematic/frozen counts, NWH enabled, throttleIn on the friend's ride - not asserted
REPORT: does the owner's own scooter follow the friend's ride (sampled on the host)
the friend holds full throttle 5 s through the NWH input-provider layer a key press feeds
REPORT (suspect A): dist = how far the friend's ride moved under 5 s of throttle - not asserted
REPORT: how far the owner's own scooter moved meanwhile - not asserted

REPORT (suspect B): the OWNER clicks his scooter while the friend rides it (DriveVehicle -> owner-ride patch -> board request; a scooter has 0 passenger seats). drivenRemotely= is recorded. The expect_log shows the first toast the owner was shown; a FAIL there means the owner was shown NOTHING
REVERSE: the owner takes his own scooter again (native DriveVehicle)
DESIGNED: the friend clicks the scooter the owner rides - CanDriveGhost refuses 'owner-using' (VehicleManager.cs:2969); the toast the friend gets is in the report
